title: Home practical guide and safety card: rainbow glass
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 23 (Home practical guide and safety card: rainbow glass (portal worksheet; never look at the Sun))
intro: Lesson 23: White light and the spectrum. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To split white light into a spectrum
equipment: Sunlight through a window or a torch
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stand the glass on a sunny windowsill; never look at the Sun
Put white paper on the floor below
Move the paper until you see a band of colours
Try with a torch in a dark room

questions.q: Big question: where do a rainbow's colours come from?
questions.a: From white sunlight, split by refraction in raindrops.
